sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Place *nem* before the finite verb to make a simple negative sentence.

Word order rule: nem always parks itself directly in front of the verb it’s negating, not at the start or end of the sentence the way English ‘not’ sometimes drifts. Nem dolgozom, Károly nem tanul — same slot every time, right before the action word. Lock that position in and negation becomes almost mechanical.
